definitions.gloss: good guy; hero; the good party
definitions.explanation: A virtuous character or person, contrasted with a villain. Often used of clear-cut heroes in stories or of the 'good side' in a dispute.
In health and nutrition, bacteria that benefit the body, especially in the gut. Usually said as 善玉菌.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{善玉|ぜんだま}が{勝|か}つ。
examples.english: In this movie the good guy wins.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}の{物語|ものがたり}は{善玉|ぜんだま}と{悪玉|あくだま}がはっきりしている。
examples.english: Old tales have a clear good guy and bad guy.

examples.japanese: {誰|だれ}を{善玉|ぜんだま}とするかで、{物語|ものがたり}の{印象|いんしょう}が{大|おお}きく{変|か}わる。
examples.english: Who you make the good guy greatly changes the impression of the story.

examples.japanese: {善玉菌|ぜんだまきん}を{増|ふ}やす。
ヨーグルトには{善玉菌|ぜんだまきん}が{含|ふく}まれている。
{腸内|ちょうない}の{善玉菌|ぜんだまきん}を{増|ふ}やすには、{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}をとるとよい。
examples.english: To increase good bacteria in the gut, it helps to consume dietary fiber.

notes:
Compound of {善|ぜん} (good) + {玉|だま} (ball; figuratively a person or thing). The contrasting word is {悪玉|あくだま}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {善玉|ぜんだま}と{悪玉|あくだま}: the good guy and the bad guy
- {善玉菌|ぜんだまきん}: good (beneficial) bacteria
- {善玉|ぜんだま}コレステロール: HDL ('good') cholesterol

USAGE:
- Sense 1 is somewhat old-fashioned and storybook in flavor.
- Sense 2 (善玉菌, 善玉コレステロール) is very common in everyday health talk.
